full_text: Why are you not married? I'm certain I was never meant to marry. I'm a confirmed bachelor. I'm incurable. Marriage would make me deceitful, and I don't ever want that. I think you are only acting strong. No, I am strong. For who? Not for me, I hope. I think it's the expectations and assumptions of others that cause heartache. I want you flat on your back, helpless, tender, open, with only me to help. And then I want you strongly. I hear your voice say my name when I dream. And when I wake up, there are tears streaming down my face. I just miss you.
